convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for BvsB indicator and external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and money management. Custom smoothing methods and applied price enums not available in built-in indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position via BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose inputs are true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size from MM; FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; BALANCE=fraction of balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar (SignalBar=1, so Ind[1] vs Sign[1]) for trend direction and current bar (Ind[0] vs Sign[0]) for crossover confirmation. Long entry: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (was above on prev bar) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (crossed below on signal bar). Short entry: Ind[1]<Sign[1] (was below on prev bar) AND Ind[0]>=Sign[0] (crossed above on signal bar). UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to position open functions for trade validation. LoadHistory called each tick for series synchronization. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up on deinit. Recount flag handles copy buffer failures with retry on next tick.
python_conversion_notes: The BvsB custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python using the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library functions (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing methods). The Applied_price_ enum extends beyond standard MT5 prices (adds Simpl, Quarter, TrendFollow, Demark prices). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose which handle order execution with margin calculation, deviation, and signal time validation. The conditional position sizing (MMMode enum) requires implementing 5 different money management modes. Signal logic is bar-based with new-bar guard and SignalBar offset, making it compatible with bar-by-bar backtesting at H4 resolution.
